extDesc.message: Remembers your preferred Echo360 lecture speed and re-applies it automatically every time you open a recording.
extDesc.description: Shown in the Chrome Web Store listing and the extensions page.

speedNote.message: Every Echo360 recording you open will play at this speed automatically. The host player's own speed menu will follow along.

privacyNote.message: The only thing this extension stores is a single number — your preferred speed. No accounts, no cloud, no tracking. The lecture video stays in your tab. Nothing leaves your device.
